column3: this is the power of the wise
by a glance, a smile pure, lovely and cool, tinted with compassion (fragment)
by men with intellect skilled in yoga
human, animal, tree, born of heat
humans, creepers, grass, up to Brahma
the mind will soon be pure
giving delight to mind and eyes
delighting mind and eyes, lovely in limbs
increasing delight of mind and eyes
from the sub-part birth of Hari, of Manu
of mind, speech, sight, senses, effort
of him whose path is inferred by mind and speech
by mind, speech, sight and conduct
fearless, proud with mind's strength and boon
knot of heart of the mind, of this
to the one whose path is unseen, for inner existence
within and without, covered by the womb
by hosts of mantras, you of great form, therefore
by mantra and tantra, a flaw
by enjoyments with heart of mantras, the Self in the Self
falling from the peak of Mount Mandara
O dull-minded, vile destroyer of family
mandara, kunda, kuruba, utpala, champaka, punnaga, nagakesara, bakula, lotus, parijata
by winds of the Mandara forest
thinks the Lord is not the lord
thinking it destroyer of austerity, splendour and fame
anger toward the wife by self
anger as if wishing to burn
I think Achyuta has no fear
I think indeed of the earth
frightened of the fear of birth, death, eating of one another
let there be anger, not afflicted
in sons, wealth, houses dependent on possessiveness
worshipped by the lords of immortals surrounding
removed the burden of hundreds of akshauhinis of demon-dynasty kings, self-reliant
was in me through bad company, that birth
my illusion of all particulars, denial, experience of bliss of liberation
of those with firmly held belief "mine, I"
this given to me by sages
of me intoxicated by pride in lordship
by me for becoming the Self
do not follow what is commanded by me
by me, who knows the truth, with vision
with rays splitting fingers, lovely leaf
attentive to what was told by me
endowed with all worlds prepared by me
as many as worshipped by me
I am Maya, of the Lord of the world
in me of endless qualities, endless
minds bound by attachment to me
mind and thought offered to me
whose Self is offered to me wishes
by their own karmic ripening fixed on me
in me, the principle of ego
in me, the Self of ether
in me, Self, Lord of all
of those with minds fixed on me
speech and thought fixed on me
Achyuta will come to me, enemy-minded
of those solely devoted to me
mind solely in me, none other than me
to the emerald-dark body, who obtained Shri
mortal, even giving success of purpose
the Adhokshaja bearing a mortal body
the day and night of mortals
appearance of objects and senses, sleepless, unwounded
of those who understand the essence
longing for the stainless one of excellent fame
with jasmine, resorted to by intoxicated bees
having obstructed, overwhelmed with excess of joy
in the rule of those stationed
of the pain of others, undiscerned
of unmanifest jiva and mahat too
his mind fixed on the unmanifest path
to the form of pure being for no further birth
by whom the glorious feet are served, unseen
praised by us, of lovely stories
you should wander in the great end
with the force of loud laughter
Mahat-tattva from the unmanifest impelled by time
from Mahat-tattva transforming, born of the Lord's power
from the heart of the greatest, from the mouth
among the greatest, you know the sin
anointing with the dust of great feet
mind fearful of offence to the great
without the grace of the great
by the arrangement of great and small
from disrespect of the great, born of the unborn
Mahat, ego and others created the egg
to be sought by the great
sought by the great: liberation, bliss of nirvana
by Sarasvati, water like the great mind
for those who serve daily by Vedic rule, all sins
served by hosts of great sages
the two great-souled with compassionate smiling glances
with costly diamond staffs, fans, peacock chowries
costly furniture, elephants, chariots, horses, men and women
to the limb of the great sacrifice
was great in the three worlds
was great, remembering the inauspicious Self
